title: Sparkly crystal ball
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='ball' cx='38%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#dff6ff'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#7fd4f0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3a7bd5'/>

    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe9a8' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe9a8' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- pedestal -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='20' ry='6' fill='#b07a3a'/>
  <path d='M32 78 Q50 88 68 78 L66 70 Q50 77 34 70 Z' fill='#8a5a24'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='16' ry='5' fill='#d99a4e'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='27' fill='url(#ball)'/>

  <ellipse cx='46' cy='48' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.28'/>

    <path d='M16 60 L17.2 63.5 L20.7 64.7 L17.2 65.9 L16 69.4 L14.8 65.9 L11.3 64.7 L14.8 63.5 Z'/>
    <path d='M50 8 L51 12 L55 13 L51 14 L50 18 L49 14 L45 13 L49 12 Z'/>

    <circle cx='70' cy='48' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='28' cy='46' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='66' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='38' cy='64' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='26' r='1.5'/>
